title: How much mobile internet costs while travelling: travel eSIM prices in 196 countries (2026)
description: Final retail prices (RUB) of Letsim travel eSIM plans for 196 destinations as of 23 Nov 2026: 1 GB / 7 days, 10 GB / 30 days, price per GB, unlimited for 7 days and cheaper covering regional plans. Median 10 GB / 30 days — 2,465 RUB; Turkey 590 RUB vs New Caledonia 28,690 RUB. Prices of one store, not market averages. Page: https://letsim.ru/issledovaniya/stoimost-interneta-v-poezdke Disclosure: conducted by Letsim, a commercial travel eSIM provider that sells the plans discussed.
